{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the final value
print(f"Final mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Return the value for submission
mean_revenue"}
